scope: Every UI operation with milestone 6 in scripts/ui-operation-inventory.json

owner_status_definitions.owned: A production backend query or command owns the operation's server-side contract. This does not claim that its UI control or evidence is complete.
owner_status_definitions.partial: A named production boundary supplies only part of the operation; missing_owner states the remaining runtime owner.
owner_status_definitions.missing: No production owner supplies the operation; missing_owner names the boundary that must be introduced.
owner_status_definitions.client_owned: The accepted operation is intentionally browser-local and needs no backend authority or durable server persistence.

project-shell-read.authorization: Bearer-authenticated API; the collection reader owns bounded search across current Project name, Objective statement, and registered profile label plus status/profile filters and pagination, while detail binds the requested Project and optional semantic selection.
project-shell-read.persistence: PostgreSQL Project, ProjectDefinition, Objective, authority, projection, and task summary records composed under one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction.
project-shell-read.recovery: Returns explicit unauthorized, invalid-query, invalid-cursor, not-found, unavailable, or failed-read states; exact query/result hashes prevent client substitution, and the owner never mutates or falls back to fixture data.

project-resume-read.authorization: Bearer-authenticated collection and Project-scoped shell reads; clients cannot provide or replace retained task, origin, focus, Objective, definition, or destination identity.
project-resume-read.persistence: PostgreSQL V048 immutable ProjectInquiry save receipts retain the latest server-verified Graph request, ProjectInquiry Objective, exact definition and snapshot, origin, focus references, selection, and return destination. Both routes compose the same retained tuple under one repeatable-read Project snapshot.
project-resume-read.recovery: Returns an exact available task only when its immutable hashes, active ProjectInquiry revision, Project status, and current ProjectDefinition still agree. Missing tasks open Brief; archived, changed-definition, and changed-task states retain inspectable context but fall back to Brief; unverifiable records expose retry without client reconstruction.

project-profile-command.authorization: Bearer authentication plus one server-configured registered human; requests cannot carry Actor or grant identity, and reset additionally requires exact current revision plus Project ownership.
project-profile-command.persistence: PostgreSQL V044 atomically stores an immutable command receipt with a new Project, copied Project-owned ProjectDefinition, active Objective/focus, and exact registered-profile origin. Reset archives the prior Project additively and never deletes retained or unrelated authority.
project-profile-command.recovery: Stable command and idempotency identities return the exact retained receipt; stale reset, denied principal, unknown profile/version/hash, and conflicting identity fail without partial Project creation or profile fallback.

project-import-command.authorization: Bearer authentication plus one server-configured registered human who must own the exact retained source Project. The request cannot carry Actor or capability identity and must bind the current Project, ProjectDefinition, focused Objective, explicit reviewed admission, and bounded copy scope.
project-import-command.persistence: PostgreSQL V049 atomically creates a new derived Project with copied exact ProjectDefinition and focused Objective, plus one immutable ancestry receipt that binds source and result record hashes. Source history, sources, Work, Reviews, and authority remain unchanged in the source Project.
project-import-command.recovery: Stable command and idempotency identities return the exact receipt; a read-only assessment distinguishes confirmed, unknown, and conflicting effects; the ancestry query re-exposes the owned receipt. Stale source bindings, unsupported objective dependencies, denied ownership, and conflicts fail without partial creation.

project-profile-command-recovery.production_owner: POST /api/queries/project-profile-command-recovery -> PostgresProjectProfileRuntime.assessProjectProfileCommandRecovery; eligible retry delegates to the existing create/reset command owner
project-profile-command-recovery.authorization: Bearer authentication plus the server-configured registered human. The full exact create/reset request is validated and hashed server-side; another request or actor's retained receipt is never disclosed.
project-profile-command-recovery.persistence: PostgreSQL V044 immutable Project-profile command receipts remain the only durable result. The assessment is a content-hashed repeatable-read composition and creates no generic recovery record, event, mutation, or second ledger.
project-profile-command-recovery.recovery: Classifies effect_confirmed, outcome_unknown, or unavailable_to_verify; inventories retained request/receipt/Project records; offers only exact idempotent redelivery through the existing owner or exact navigation; and supplies a receipt-bound Brief return or safe Projects fallback.

client-task-return.production_owner: Browser route state bound to server-supplied Project and object identities
client-task-return.authorization: The browser may retain origin, focus, and scroll only; it cannot invent a Project, semantic object, or command identity.
client-task-return.persistence: Session-local browser navigation state; no server persistence is required by the accepted boundary.
client-task-return.recovery: A missing or stale origin must fall back to a server-supplied safe destination without implying command success.

project-taxonomy-read.authorization: Bearer-authenticated registry and Project-scoped reads; Project taxonomy binds the exact retained ProjectDefinition revision and exact template profile identity/version/hash when present.
project-taxonomy-read.persistence: PostgreSQL immutable registered profile versions plus Project-owned immutable ProjectDefinition revisions expose purpose, object/relationship/source roles, validators, Work/model/Review roles, terminology, supported places, and unavailable operations.
project-taxonomy-read.recovery: Unknown profile, unavailable version, hash mismatch, and definition-binding mismatch return a typed unsupported-profile state or command error with Projects as the safe destination; no nearby profile supplies fallback semantics.

brief-read.authorization: Bearer-authenticated Project-scoped read with exact snapshot and optional baseline controls.
brief-read.persistence: PostgreSQL composes ProjectDefinition, Objective, attention, changes, recent decisions, and suggested-action references.
brief-read.recovery: Distinguishes invalid, stale, corrupt, unavailable, not-found, and successful reads without mutation.

project-objective-command.authorization: Bearer authentication plus a server-resolved human principal and exact active FrameProjectObjective capability grant. The request cannot carry Actor, grant, Objective identity, revision, or timestamps and must bind the exact current Project, ProjectDefinition, and focused Objective or its reviewed absence.
project-objective-command.persistence: PostgreSQL V050 atomically appends the reviewed ProjectObjective revision, advances the exact focus and focus history, and retains one immutable receipt binding rough and proposed wording, Project/definition/prior/result record hashes, capability grant, and exact Brief destination.
project-objective-command.recovery: Stable command and idempotency identities replay the exact receipt. A read-only assessment distinguishes confirmed, unknown, conflicting, and differently owned outcomes; confirmed effects return to the exact resulting Objective in Brief, while uncertain outcomes return safely to a fresh Brief read.

suggested-action-read.authorization: Bearer-authenticated Project read; server resolves current Actor-dependent readiness and exact immutable action basis.
suggested-action-read.persistence: PostgreSQL Project inquiry, ProjectDefinition, Objective, snapshot, context/evidence, Work, and grant facts.
suggested-action-read.recovery: Returns ready, stale, unavailable, invalid, not-found, or failed-read outcomes without client-derived readiness.

suggested-action-invoke.authorization: Bearer authentication plus server-resolved human principal and exact InvokeSuggestedAction capability grant; request-carried authority is rejected.
suggested-action-invoke.persistence: PostgreSQL immutable idempotent invocation, command/event/outbox, WorkUnit, InteractionRun, and result bindings; artifacts use S3 where applicable.
suggested-action-invoke.recovery: Stable command identity supports safe reread; unknown effect is reconciled through the invocation view, interaction replay, cancellation assessment, and exact destinations.

source-read.authorization: Bearer-authenticated Project-scoped collection/detail read with exact ProjectSource identity.
source-read.persistence: PostgreSQL ProjectSource revisions, retained source/artifact identity, rights, parse coverage, preview spans, downstream use, and authority position.
source-read.recovery: Returns not-found or unavailable states and never converts a retained copy into endorsed meaning.

source-registration.authorization: Bearer authentication plus a server-resolved human principal and exact RegisterProjectSource capability grant. The request binds the exact active Project and ProjectDefinition, one registered source role, reviewed identity/material, and explicit copy rights without carrying Actor, grant, authority IDs, storage location, or record timestamps.
source-registration.persistence: Verified content-addressed bytes and PostgreSQL V051 atomically retain server-derived Author, Work, WorkVersion, Artifact, ArtifactManifest, RightsDecision, ProjectSource membership, immutable ancestry, and one idempotent receipt. Registration never endorses source meaning.
source-registration.recovery: Stable command and idempotency identities replay the exact receipt. A read-only assessment distinguishes confirmed, unknown, conflicting, and differently owned outcomes, returning either the exact registered source or the safe Project source collection.

source-reuse.production_owner: GET /api/queries/projects/:projectId/source-reuse-options -> PostgresProjectSourceReuseOptionsReader; POST /api/commands/projects/:projectId/sources/reuse and POST /api/queries/projects/:projectId/source-reuse-recovery -> PostgresProjectSourceReuseAuthority
source-reuse.authorization: Bearer authentication plus a server-resolved human principal and exact ReuseProjectSource capability grant. The request binds the exact current target Project and ProjectDefinition, one registered source role, and one exact current originating ProjectSource identity and copy. Actor, grant, new membership identity, storage, and record timestamps remain server-owned. The origin membership must be owned by the authenticated human and its retained RightsDecision must still permit the available copy.
source-reuse.persistence: PostgreSQL V052 atomically appends only the target ProjectSource membership and immutable reuse receipt. Canonical Work, WorkVersion, authors, Artifact, ArtifactManifest, RightsDecision, storage, and bytes remain unchanged and are referenced exactly.
source-reuse.recovery: Stable command and idempotency identities replay the exact receipt. The read-only assessment distinguishes confirmed, unknown, conflicting, and differently owned outcomes and returns either the exact reused ProjectSource or the safe target Project source collection.

source-processing.production_owner: GET /api/queries/projects/:projectId/sources/:projectSourceId/processing plus POST /api/commands/projects/:projectId/sources/:projectSourceId/processing and POST /api/queries/projects/:projectId/sources/:projectSourceId/processing-recovery -> PostgresProjectSourceProcessingAuthority
source-processing.authorization: Bearer authentication plus a server-resolved human principal and exact StartProjectSourceProcessing capability grant. The request binds the exact current Project, ProjectDefinition, active ProjectSource, registered source role, and Petra-owned processing family while Work identity, worker identity, limits, authority, and timestamps remain server-owned.
source-processing.persistence: PostgreSQL V053 reserves one command per exact ProjectSource, stores the server-composed WorkUnit and WorkerInputManifest before execution, starts the durable Work lifecycle, registers meaningful stages, and finalizes one immutable receipt without changing source meaning or Project authority.
source-processing.recovery: Stable command and idempotency identities replay the exact receipt. A read-only assessment distinguishes confirmed, pending or absent unknown effect, conflicting identity, and differently owned commands; the composed Details read preserves the exact source, Work paths, representation, limitations, and return.

source-processing-read.production_owner: GET /api/queries/projects/:projectId/sources/:projectSourceId/processing -> PostgresProjectSourceProcessingAuthority, with exact links to the existing ProjectSource and Project Work reads
source-processing-read.authorization: Bearer-authenticated exact source and Work reads.
source-processing-read.persistence: PostgreSQL composes current Project/profile/source bindings, parse permission, retained representation, the exact processing Work identity and its Work detail/operation destinations.
source-processing-read.recovery: The Details read exposes explicit ready, unavailable, active, and terminal states with limitations and exact return; command reconciliation remains a distinct read-only assessment.

source-revision-intake.production_owner: POST /api/commands/projects/:projectId/sources/:projectSourceId/revisions plus POST /api/queries/projects/:projectId/source-revision-recovery -> PostgresProjectSourceRevisionAuthority; its retained receipt hands exact predecessor exclusion and successor replacement to the existing source-lifecycle and source-replacement owners
source-revision-intake.authorization: Bearer authentication plus a server-resolved human principal and exact AddProjectSourceRevision capability grant. The request binds the exact active Project, current ProjectDefinition, and current active predecessor ProjectSource without carrying Actor, grant, successor identity, storage, or authority timestamps.
source-revision-intake.persistence: Verified content-addressed bytes and PostgreSQL V054 atomically retain a new WorkVersion for the predecessor Work, Artifact, ArtifactManifest, RightsDecision, active successor ProjectSource, and immutable idempotent intake receipt. The predecessor is not silently changed.
source-revision-intake.recovery: Stable command and idempotency identities replay the exact receipt. A read-only assessment distinguishes confirmed, unknown, conflicting, and differently owned outcomes; the confirmed receipt supplies exact ExcludeProjectSource and CreateProjectSourceReplacement handoff inputs without bypassing their independent grants, receipts, or expected-state checks.

source-replacement.authorization: Bearer authentication plus server-resolved human principal and exact CreateProjectSourceReplacement grant.
source-replacement.persistence: PostgreSQL immutable replacement record, command execution, event, outbox, and receipt; source materials remain retained.
source-replacement.recovery: Idempotent receipt and separate authorized retraction preserve active/retracted lineage; this does not register new source bytes.

source-lifecycle.authorization: Bearer authentication plus server-resolved human principal and exact ExcludeProjectSource or RestoreProjectSource grant.
source-lifecycle.persistence: PostgreSQL additive ProjectSource status revisions, immutable command/event/outbox records, and lifecycle receipt; source material is retained.
source-lifecycle.recovery: Preview names blockers and retained dependents; idempotent exclude/restore receipts support reconciliation and compensating restore.

source-link-removal.authorization: Bearer authentication plus a server-resolved human principal and the exact ExcludeProjectSource grant. The preview supplies and the command revalidates exact current Project, ProjectDefinition, and active ProjectSource revision/hash bindings; Actor, grant, authority time, event identity, and retention outcomes remain server-owned.
source-link-removal.persistence: PostgreSQL V055 composes the existing atomic ExcludeProjectSource status revision, command/event/outbox, and lifecycle receipt with an immutable exact-context link-removal receipt. Global Work identity, WorkVersion, ArtifactManifest, bytes, parsed representations, dependents, provenance, and history remain retained; local-copy deletion is never inferred.
source-link-removal.recovery: Stable command and idempotency identities replay the exact composed receipt after restart. A read-only assessment distinguishes confirmed, unknown, conflicting, and differently owned outcomes and returns either the exact excluded ProjectSource or the safe Sources collection. RestoreProjectSource remains the separately previewed compensating command.

source-local-copy-deletion.authorization: Bearer authentication plus a server-resolved human principal and the exact DeleteLocalSourceCopy grant. Preview and command bind current Project, ProjectDefinition, ProjectSource, ArtifactManifest, Artifact, store, object key, content hash, size, and media type; the command revalidates all database facts and the exact available object.
source-local-copy-deletion.persistence: PostgreSQL V056 records a durable pending deletion intent before storage delivery and an immutable receipt/tombstone after the exact content-addressed object is absent. Shared manifests, shared Project use, derived Artifact inputs, active Work, and open Review dependencies block deletion; Project link, canonical identity, manifest, rights, selectors, provenance, and history remain retained.
source-local-copy-deletion.recovery: Stable command and idempotency identities resume a pending storage attempt after restart. Read-only recovery distinguishes a confirmed immutable receipt, no observed effect, pending delivery with durable intent, command conflict, and differently owned attempts; an exact retry safely finalizes either deleted-now or already-absent-after-intent outcomes.

review-read.authorization: Bearer-authenticated Project-scoped read binds exact ReviewSession/member and current profile/working identities.
review-read.persistence: PostgreSQL ReviewSession lifecycle, member, candidate, relationship, basis, validation, ChangeSet, Approval, command/event, projection, and outcome records.
review-read.recovery: Returns exact lifecycle and member outcomes or explicit not-found/unavailable/corrupt states; selection remains client-local.

review-correction.authorization: Bearer authentication plus server-resolved human principal and exact CorrectReviewCandidate grant.
review-correction.persistence: PostgreSQL additive Claim, WorkingCandidate, WorkingRelationship, Review member/session, command/event/outbox, and receipt revisions.
review-correction.recovery: Stable command identity, expected hashes, conflict errors, and exact resulting records support safe reread without deciding or applying the member.

review-basis.authorization: Bearer authentication plus server-resolved human principal and exact ReviseReviewCandidateBasis grant.
review-basis.persistence: PostgreSQL additive material source basis, Claim, WorkingCandidate, WorkingRelationship, Review member/session, command/event/outbox, and receipt revisions.
review-basis.recovery: Expected identities and hashes prevent stale rebinding; exact results permit reread while preserving correction and decision boundaries.

review-separation.authorization: Bearer authentication plus server-resolved human principal and exact SeparateReviewSessionMember grant.
review-separation.persistence: PostgreSQL advances the source ReviewSession and creates one immutable single-member ReviewSession with an exact partition receipt.
review-separation.recovery: Idempotent command and partition receipt preserve retained members and reject stale, incompatible, or atomic ChangeSet splits.

review-apply.authorization: Bearer authentication plus one server-resolved human holding current SubmitChangeSet, RecordApproval, and ApplyChangeSet grants.
review-apply.persistence: PostgreSQL canonical ChangeSet, Approval, command execution, domain event, authority revisions, projection checkpoint, and per-member Apply result.
review-apply.recovery: Checkpoint revalidation and exact result distinguish applied, conflicted, retained, unknown-effect, and reconciliation-required outcomes.

review-reject.authorization: Bearer authentication plus one server-resolved human holding current SubmitChangeSet and RecordApproval grants; rejection cannot carry or send ApplyChangeSet authority.
review-reject.persistence: PostgreSQL canonical ChangeSet, rejected Approval, command execution, domain event, and exact retained rejection checkpoint request; no second Review ledger and no target evidence authority revision.
review-reject.recovery: Checkpoint revalidation, exact retained request, ordered two-command prefix, canonical D020 assessment, and restart replay distinguish rejected from reconciliation-required without inferring no effect from absence.

review-lifecycle.authorization: Bearer authentication plus server-resolved human principal and exact DeferReviewSession or ReopenReviewSession grant.
review-lifecycle.persistence: PostgreSQL additive ReviewSession lifecycle revision, command/event/outbox, and immutable lifecycle receipt.
review-lifecycle.recovery: Expected revision/hash and idempotent command identity return current state on duplicate and explicit stale/not-authorized outcomes.

review-refresh.authorization: Bearer authentication plus server-resolved human principal and exact RefreshReviewSession grant.
review-refresh.persistence: PostgreSQL additive ReviewSession revision rebinding compatible current working heads with command/event/outbox and receipt.
review-refresh.recovery: Retains the stale revision, rejects incompatible current heads, and returns the exact refreshed session or explicit conflict.

graph-read.authorization: Bearer-authenticated exact Project, ProjectDefinition, snapshot, semantic focus, position, and task request.
graph-read.persistence: PostgreSQL authority/working/history records plus Neo4j authoritative relationship projection; selections and layout remain client-local.
graph-read.recovery: Explicit invalid, unsupported, not-found, stale-definition, stale-snapshot, source-incompatible, projection-incoherent, and unavailable states.

graph-question-command.authorization: Bearer authentication plus a server-resolved human principal and exact active SaveProjectInquiry capability grant; the request cannot carry Actor, grant, Objective, role, or receipt authority.
graph-question-command.persistence: PostgreSQL V048 atomically retains one ProjectObjective and immutable receipt binding the exact Project, ProjectDefinition, ProjectInquiry role, graph request, question, snapshot, focus or selection, origin, and return destination without granting graph authority.
graph-question-command.recovery: Stable command and idempotency identities return the exact retained receipt, conflicting identities fail closed, and a missing receipt is reported as outcome_unknown with only exact-request redelivery allowed.

work-read.authorization: Bearer-authenticated Project and exact WorkUnit read with ProjectDefinition Work support.
work-read.persistence: PostgreSQL WorkUnit revisions, WorkerInput/Output manifests, resources, interaction/replay records, result summaries, and destinations where registered.
work-read.recovery: Returns exact state, stages, inputs, resources, results, limitations, or explicit unsupported/not-found/unavailable destinations.

work-operations.production_owner: GET /api/queries/projects/:projectId/work/:workUnitId/operations and POST /api/commands/projects/:projectId/work/:workUnitId -> PostgresProjectWorkOperations -> canonical WorkUnit authority and durable interaction delivery
work-operations.authorization: Bearer authentication plus a server-resolved human principal and exact active ManageProjectWork capability grant. Requests bind the exact Project, WorkUnit revision, specification hash, command identity, and any input or plan revision; they cannot carry Actor or grant authority.
work-operations.persistence: PostgreSQL V045 retains required-input requests/responses, immutable plan revisions, current plan heads, idempotent operation receipts, and canonical WorkUnit lifecycle revisions. Start, cancellation, and retry reuse the existing WorkUnit authority rather than adding a parallel lifecycle.
work-operations.recovery: Snapshot reads compose required input, plan, delivery, controls, retry eligibility, results, and exact destinations. Pending command reservations reconcile disconnects and unknown effects; exact command/idempotency replays return one receipt, while stale, conflicting, unauthorized, unavailable, and missing targets fail without duplicate execution.

work-restart-assessment.production_owner: GET /api/queries/projects/:projectId/work/:workUnitId/operations and POST /api/commands/projects/:projectId/work/:workUnitId/start-again -> PostgresProjectWorkOperations registered fresh-input transition -> distinct canonical WorkUnit attempt
work-restart-assessment.authorization: A trusted owning service must first register exact terminal prior Work, distinct requested fresh Work, genuinely different immutable input, same workflow/task/worker/service/capability boundary, and no implicit output reuse. Mutation then requires bearer authentication and a server-resolved human with the exact active ManageProjectWork grant; client or model prose cannot create or select replacement Work.
work-restart-assessment.persistence: PostgreSQL V058 retains immutable workflow registrations, pending/completed authenticated receipts, and exact prior-Work to fresh-Work attempt lineage. The fresh Work enters attempt 1 under its own immutable specification and input manifest; prior Work, attempts, outputs, usage, and domain authority remain unchanged.
work-restart-assessment.recovery: Before every prerequisite is registered, Start again remains explicitly unavailable. Pending commands reconcile requested, queued, or running fresh Work after delivery loss; completed command/idempotency replay returns the same receipt after restart. Stale prior Work, changed replacement Work, same-content input, mismatched workflow/service/capability, pending required input, and conflicting identities fail without implicit cloning or duplicate execution.

work-resume.production_owner: GET /api/queries/projects/:projectId/work/:workUnitId/operations and POST /api/commands/projects/:projectId/work/:workUnitId/resume -> PostgresProjectWorkOperations -> canonical WorkUnit checkpoint/resume transitions
work-resume.authorization: A trusted owning service must first register compatibility for the exact current retained checkpoint, immutable Work specification, input manifest, workflow, Actor, and capability boundary. The mutation then requires bearer authentication and a server-resolved human with the exact active ManageProjectWork grant; neither the client nor model prose can register compatibility or select a different checkpoint.
work-resume.persistence: PostgreSQL V057 admits canonical checkpointed Work revisions and retains immutable compatibility registrations, exact checkpoint-to-running transition lineage, idempotent command receipts, and every prior Work revision. Resume preserves Work identity and attempt and changes no domain authority.
work-resume.recovery: Before trusted registration, the operation is explicitly unavailable. Pending commands reconcile an already-applied exact transition; completed command/idempotency replay returns the same receipt after server restart. Stale Work/checkpoint/specification, changed authority, conflicting identity, unresolved input, missing bytes, and unregistered transitions fail without duplicate execution.

interaction-delivery.authorization: Bearer-authenticated exact run/thread/connection and replay checkpoint; the client cannot alter recorded event identities.
interaction-delivery.persistence: PostgreSQL InteractionRun, delivery/replay records, WorkUnit state, grounded response/execution records, and S3 artifacts.
interaction-delivery.recovery: Supports detach, restore, reconnect, resume-after-sequence, full replay, aborted/write-error delivery recording, and explicit unknown-run/invalid-checkpoint states.

thread-read.authorization: Bearer-authenticated Project/thread-scoped read with exact ProjectDefinition and retained turn bindings.
thread-read.persistence: PostgreSQL durable ProjectThread revisions and immutable completed turn bindings.
thread-read.recovery: Returns retained hash-only limitations for legacy prompts and explicit not-found/unavailable states; append/branch commands are absent.

petra-interaction.production_owner: GET /api/queries/projects/:projectId/model-readiness plus POST /api/interactions/run -> ProjectModelReadinessService -> PostgresProjectModelReadinessReader -> PetraInteractionRuntime -> certified grounded-synthesis executor and durable terminal
petra-interaction.authorization: Bearer authentication plus a server-reread exact Project, current ProjectDefinition, focused Objective, snapshot, ContextPacket, EvidencePacket, role certification, live managed-ChatGPT provider, and registered-prompt binding. Client prose cannot select a role, provider, permission, authority effect, or nearby context.
petra-interaction.persistence: PostgreSQL supplies current Project/definition/Objective authority and immutable context/evidence packets; accepted runs retain WorkUnit, interaction, execution, grounded response, replay/delivery, and S3 artifact records.
petra-interaction.recovery: Missing, stale, mismatched, unsupported, logged-out, model-unavailable, and certification-drift states fail before Work starts. Accepted runs retain streaming, terminal failure, disconnect, restart, and exact replay behavior without duplicate model execution.

communication-read.persistence: PostgreSQL grounded response, ProjectDefinition communication metadata, references, force, limitations, action links, and validation facts.
communication-read.recovery: Returns exact not-found, invalid-binding, failed-read, and no-store outcomes without client-generated claims.

suggested-action-parity.production_owner: GET /api/queries/projects/:projectId/suggested-actions?action_kind=run_grounded_synthesis plus POST /api/commands/projects/:projectId/suggested-actions/:suggestedActionId/invoke -> PostgresSuggestedActionViewReader -> SuggestedActionInvocationCoordinator -> PostgresSuggestedActionInvocationAuthorityRepository; PostgresCommunicationPlanReader composes the same receipt as Petra's action report
suggested-action-parity.authorization: The server derives the exact registered action, readiness, and grant reference, then re-resolves the authenticated human principal before the shared invocation command. Direct and conversational presentations carry the same request contract and cannot supply Actor, grant, Project, Work, interaction, trace, result, or authority effect.
suggested-action-parity.persistence: PostgreSQL retains the immutable SuggestedAction basis, invocation receipt, expected Work identity, canonical Work revisions, GroundedResponse, InteractionRun, History destinations, and current recovery eligibility. Model prose creates no command or authority.
suggested-action-parity.recovery: The exact invocation reread exposes pending registration, canonical result, idempotent pre-registration retry, reconnect, cancellation, Work and result inspection, and semantic Work/History destinations without duplicating authority.

review-interrupt.production_owner: POST /api/commands/reviews/resolve -> server-resolved direct Review authority -> DurableReviewInterruptCoordinator -> DurableReviewInterruptProductBindingLoader -> Postgres Review apply/reject boundaries
review-interrupt.authorization: Bearer authentication resolves the same server-owned human Actor and capability grants as direct Review Apply or Reject. The retained command prompt, current ProjectThread, Review member, WorkUnit, InteractionRun, and direct checkpoint are reread exactly; client or model prose cannot supply identity, grants, commands, or authority.
review-interrupt.persistence: PostgreSQL retains InteractionRun, pending/responded interrupt revisions, exact Review commands, Approval, events, and outcomes. The canonical response bytes and retained command prompt use verified ArtifactStore bytes with immutable PostgreSQL Artifact authority records.
review-interrupt.recovery: Exact response replay after process restart returns the same idempotent direct command envelopes and outcome; conflicting, stale, authority-injected, mismatched, unavailable, and unknown-effect states fail without a second effect and return exact ProjectThread, Review, Work, and originating-task context.

model-readiness.production_owner: GET /api/queries/projects/:projectId/model-readiness -> ProjectModelReadinessService -> PostgresProjectModelReadinessReader plus server-owned certified Codex runtime inspection
model-readiness.authorization: Bearer-authenticated Project-scoped read; PostgreSQL supplies current Project authority, the server chooses the registered certified role, and provider credentials remain inside the Codex sidecar.
model-readiness.persistence: PostgreSQL current Project, ProjectDefinition, focused Objective, immutable ContextPacket/EvidencePacket and their stored hashes are repeatable-read composed with the active recorded certification and live provider account/model status.
model-readiness.recovery: Returns explicit role-not-registered, role-binding-mismatch, login-required, provider-unavailable, model-unavailable, configuration-drift, Objective-unavailable, context-not-compiled, stale-context, and profile-context-unsupported states without fallback selection.

history-read.authorization: Bearer-authenticated Project/snapshot/event/filter/cursor read with signed cursor and optional current recovery principal.
history-read.persistence: PostgreSQL canonical command/event/authority/Work/source/projection records; History stores no second ledger.
history-read.recovery: Explicit invalid/binding-mismatch/snapshot-unavailable restart, unsupported target, unknown impact, unavailable action, and exact destination states.

history-revert.production_owner: GET recovery/preview, POST recovery/plan, and POST recovery/execute -> PostgresProjectHistoryViewReader and PostgresProjectHistoryCompensationExecutor
history-revert.authorization: Bearer authentication; plan is read-only, execution re-resolves current human grants and revalidates the exact preview authority.
history-revert.persistence: Existing ChangeSet, Approval, command, event, and authority repositories record each compensation step; no generic undo ledger is added.
history-revert.recovery: Reports retained success, retained terminal failure, unretained attempt failure, not-attempted work, conflicts, and a fresh exact History/Brief return.

details-read.authorization: Bearer-authenticated exact semantic identity, Project, snapshot/definition, selection, and task intent.
details-read.persistence: PostgreSQL/Neo4j semantic detail and destination facts; origin/focus/scroll remain browser-local.
details-read.recovery: Distinguishes invalid, missing, stale, unsupported, superseded, unavailable, and safe fallback destination states.

suggested-action-feedback.production_owner: The exact SuggestedAction preview, shared invocation command, and invocation-detail reread own confirmation, retry eligibility, result, and recovery; transient dismissal and focus return remain client-owned
suggested-action-feedback.authorization: Confirmation reaches only InvokeSuggestedAction after the server re-reads the exact action and principal. Retry is exposed only by the current server-owned retry_exact_start descriptor and reuses the same immutable command and idempotency identities.
suggested-action-feedback.persistence: The immutable invocation receipt, canonical Work/result/History records, and recovery view remain authoritative. Confirmation messages, dismissal, and focus are transient browser state and cannot alter them.
suggested-action-feedback.recovery: Before Work registration, exact retry converges on the same receipt and expected Work. After registration, retry becomes ineligible and the view supplies exact reconnect, cancellation, Work, result, and History operations.

client-feedback.production_owner: Browser transient feedback and route/focus state over an owning server result
client-feedback.authorization: Dismissal and focus return do not mutate domain authority.
client-feedback.persistence: No durable server persistence; the originating result/receipt remains canonical.
client-feedback.recovery: Dismissal cannot erase the canonical result, and failed return uses the owner's safe destination.

client-preferences.authorization: Personal appearance, layout, editor, accessibility, and technical-detail disclosure do not alter Project authority.
client-preferences.persistence: Device-local persistence only; cross-device synchronization is explicitly outside the accepted Wave 6 backend boundary.
client-preferences.recovery: Scoped reset returns to product defaults without changing Project controls or domain records.

client-guide-missing.authorization: The guide is browser-owned and may link only to supported routes/actions; no visible production owner currently exists.
client-guide-missing.persistence: No server persistence is required for the guide itself.
client-guide-missing.recovery: It must retain the stable URL, starting state, expected outcomes, safe mutations, reset action, and known limits.

application-reset-partial.authorization: Bearer authentication plus the server-configured registered human, exact current Project revision, and creator ownership.
application-reset-partial.persistence: Reset atomically archives the selected Project and creates a new Project/definition/objective from one exact registered profile while preserving unrelated Projects.
application-reset-partial.recovery: An immutable idempotent receipt supplies the resulting Brief destination; the design-owned representative-data setup and stable-URL reset control remain incomplete.

operations.missing_owner: Exact attention-bearing Work references and destinations in ProjectShellView.
Visible in-product guide owner on the stable production URL (design-owned; no backend contract required).
Representative-data setup plus the stable-URL reset control and exact guide return remain design/integration owned.
